criteria.statement: System discovery projection publishes bahia-browser-v1, bahia-contextvm-v1, and bahia-service-v1 as service-key-signed NIP-51 kind 30002 relay-set events.
Each canonical relay set is sourced from its independent backend relay policy source and tests prove the sources do not bleed into one another.
Sidecar-enabled discovery fails closed when public browser relay policy is absent.
Relay-set publish failures, including aggregate OK rejection errors from the publisher path, are surfaced to the snapshot caller and stop later relay-set projection.
A publish attempt with zero relay acceptances is not treated as successful discovery projection.
